name: vromvrom-engine
install:
sudo apt-get update -y
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3.12-venv python3.12-dev
bash scripts/install.sh
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.txt
npm --prefix ihm-v2 ci
npm --prefix ihm-v2 run build

terminals.name: gui-server
terminals.description: FastAPI HMI (port 8000). Public liveness: GET /healthz. API Bearer from .env MOTEUR_API_KEY. IHM at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
